what: One-time approval of swale drainage (no curb, gutter or storm sewer) for the Steinbach North C-3 subdivision
for: Siemens (mover); C. Penner (seconder); Fehr (said he would support)
reasons_against: Sets a precedent for open ditches in all commercial zones; staff warned of fairness to other developers

what: Deny subdivision 275 3rd Street / 4 Fernwood Bay (staff recommended denial over drainage patterns)
for: a Councillor Penner (mover, not identified); Fehr; one other (not identified)
reasons_against: A binding lot-grading plan would protect drainage and give the area a drainage plan it lacks

what: Approve Variance V-2018-03 (15-foot front yards for First Street infill townhouses)
reasons_against: Setback and infill-policy consistency; Fehr also cited runoff from added hard surface and past basement flooding

what: Deny Variance V-2018-03 (formalizing the May 1 result)
reasons_against: Those against denial supported the variance (green space, existing homes already closer to the street)

what: Deny second reading of By-law 2101 (Maplewood Street 44-unit rezoning)
for: Zwaagstra; Fehr; Siemens; Funk; C. Penner
reasons_against: Good fit on a collector street with nearby multi-family; concerns could be handled in the development agreement

what: Deny a 1-foot side-yard variance at 28 Alexander Way that staff said could cause drainage and overland-flooding problems
for: Zwaagstra; D. Penner; S. Penner; B. Hiebert; Funk
reasons_against: Siemens wanted a 2-foot compromise; thought water would not be a big issue on a corner lot.

what: Approve a site-width variance for an 8-plex at 44 First Street
for: S. Penner; Zwaagstra; D. Penner; B. Hiebert; Funk
reasons_against: Siemens: more roof and parking surface could worsen known water problems behind the lot; J. Hiebert's reason not stated.

what: Deny first reading of By-law 2165 (First Street rezoning) partly because the city engineer said it would worsen drainage
against: D. Penner; a second Councillor Penner (probably S. Penner)
reasons_against: Wanted the drainage and lot questions aired at a public hearing.

what: Deny an after-the-fact 1.9-foot side-yard variance at 55 Coral Crescent (drainage and fire risk)
for: Zwaagstra; D. Penner; S. Penner; B. Hiebert; J. Hiebert; Funk
reasons_against: Preferred approval with a substantial fine.

what: Second reading of By-law 2217 (fourplex rezoning near McKenzie Avenue; drainage among neighbours' objections)
for: Zwaagstra; D. Penner; B. Hiebert; J. Hiebert; S. Penner
reasons_against: Traffic and neighbourhood fit, not drainage.

what: First reading of By-law 2233 (capital development fees and water & sewer impact fees) at 5% a year instead of staff's 7.5%
for: Zwaagstra; S. Penner; Funk; B. Hiebert; Siemens
reasons_against: Wanted 7.5% so growth (including sewer and lagoon capacity) is paid by fees, not the mill rate.

what: Second and third readings of By-law 2233 (development and water & sewer impact fees, 5% a year)
for: Zwaagstra; B. Hiebert; S. Penner; Funk; Siemens
reasons_against: Fees have fallen behind construction costs since 2012, shifting growth costs to taxpayers.

what: Second and third readings of By-law 2232, closing a First Street public lane and keeping it as a public drain
for: Zwaagstra; S. Penner; Funk; B. Hiebert; D. Penner
reasons_against: Siemens: objected on principle to the central business district's zero lot line for the related development, not to the drain. J. Hiebert: no reason stated.

what: Deny Variance V-2023-22 (4-foot side yard on PTH 52 West; drainage concerns)
for: J. Hiebert; Siemens; Funk; S. Penner; Zwaagstra
reasons_against: No reason stated on the record.

what: Variance V-2026-14: six storeys and 1.25 parking per unit for Bridgepark Manor at 290 Stone Bridge Crossing (sewer and flooding dominated the hearing)
for: Michael Zwaagstra; Susan Penner; Bill Hiebert; Jake Hiebert; Damian Penner; Mayor Earl Funk
reasons_against: Siemens: six-storey buildings belong in the central business district; the area should stay at three storeys. He did not cite sewer capacity. His earlier motion to deny died for lack of a seconder.
